metadata.name: McpTools
metadata.description: Reference > MCP tool API. Overview page. Four sections + TOC + next-reads. Generated via /tmp/gen-reference.js.

uiVariables.name: tools
uiVariables.description: 33 MCP tools across 5 groups (A:8 / B:6 / C:7 / D:9 / E:3). Each row carries name, group letter, role, and a preformatted parameters block.

methods.name: onAppear
methods.description: Seed nextReadLinks from the module-scope NEXT_READ_ENTRIES catalog (two rows: next_mcp_overview -> /tools/mcp, next_agents -> /tools/agents) and stamp currentLanguage from StringManager.language. Each row's titleKey / descriptionKey is resolved through StringManager with the reference_mcp_tools_ namespace prefix.

methods.name: onNavigate
methods.description: Client-side navigation via router.push(url). Destinations are the spec-mapped URLs enumerated in transitions: /, /tools/mcp, /tools/agents.

vars.name: tools
vars.description: 33 MCP tools across 5 groups (A:8 Lookup / B:6 Validation / C:7 Generation / D:9 Build + Runtime / E:3 API Model Discovery) rendered as one row each via cells/reference_mcp_tool_detail. Each row carries the tool name, group letter chip, one-line role, a Parameters heading, and a preformatted parameters code block (or '(no parameters)').

vars.name: nextReadLinks
vars.description: Two closing 'read next' cards pointing at /tools/mcp and /tools/agents. Seeded by onAppear from the NEXT_READ_ENTRIES static catalog and re-seeded by onToggleLanguage.
